species.name: Northern pike
why: Water 49°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 8–20 ft deep, mostly on wind-blown banks.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 90 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 135 ft, so fish stay above it.
Southeast wind at 28 mph pushes bait onto the northwest shore: try the wind-blown banks.
